title_zh: 约好先核对志愿服务所需时间

scenario.label_zh: 约好先核对志愿服务所需时间
scenario.goal_zh: 听取参与志愿服务的个人动机，并约定确认班次要求后再作承诺

context_zh: 两个朋友商量是否参加周末社区陪伴活动。
author: author-phase11-c

sentences.speaker: Asha
sentences.text: I’m thinking of volunteering at the community lunch, but my motive is partly selfish. I’d like to meet people.

sentences.speaker: Tom
sentences.text: You don’t need a perfectly noble reason to help. Wanting company doesn’t make the help worthless.

sentences.speaker: Asha
sentences.text: I work some weekends, though. I don’t want to promise a regular shift and keep cancelling.

sentences.speaker: Tom
sentences.text: That’s a real concern. Nonetheless, there may be occasional shifts that fit your schedule.

sentences.speaker: Asha
sentences.text: I’ll ask how often they need someone before I sign up.

sentences.speaker: Tom
sentences.text: Good idea. Find out the commitment first, then decide whether it works for you.
